title: Change Operating Points
text: tSwitch between operating points during simulation, 7 inputs, 2 outputs, {Settling time interval} sets tling time interval; {Operating mode} sets the mode for operating point data Import operating, {Input method}, {Number of inputs} sets the number of model inputs, {Workspace}, {Data dictionary name}, {Operating point variable} sets the name of operating point variable, {Snapshot mode} sets the operating point snapshot, {Snapshot times (sec)} sets the simulation snapshot times, {Use external source} uses input port for snapshot times, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)}, {Operating point definitions} sets the operating point data multiple table, {Bus name} sets the name of bus, {Specify bus name}, {Data Type} sets the floating point precision, {Use block for autotuning} uses block for PID autotuning workflow, {Method for starting autotuning}, {Add enable/disable port for autotuning}, {Autotuning time span (sec)} sets the autotuning experiment duration, {Number of samples to start autotuning after reaching steady-state} sets the delay to start autotuning, {Transition method} sets the operating point transition method Internal time, {Change operating point algorithm} sets the operating point transition, {Rising slew rate (/sec)} limits of derivative for increasing input, {Falling slew rate (/sec)} limits of derivative for decreasing input, {Number of samples to transition after reaching steady-state} sets the delay to transition operating points, {Number of samples to transition after completing autotuning} sets the delay to transition operating points, {Settling time upper bounds} sets the upper bound for settling time and {Settling time lower bounds} sets the lower bound for settling time. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Enable and disable changing operating points scalar
